Container.Name: minecraft-docker
Container.Overview: Minecraft server where you pick the Minecraft version and the modloader (vanilla, Fabric, Forge or NeoForge) with variables. The server is downloaded and installed on first start. Drop mod .jar files in the Mods folder.
Container.Description:
Custom Minecraft server container. Java 8/17/21/25 are included and the right one is chosen automatically from the Minecraft version.
IMPORTANT - SERVER PORT: the "Server Port" port mapping and the SERVER_PORT variable must match. The host side of the port mapping can be anything, but if you change SERVER_PORT you must change the container port in the port mapping to the same number (and the other way around).
Setup: - Set EULA to true to accept https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA - Choose MC_VERSION and LOADER. Valid versions can be listed from the container console, e.g. "mcctl loader neoforge 1.21.1", "mcctl loaders forge", "mcctl mc". - Leave LOADER_VERSION empty: the correct recommended/newest stable loader version for the chosen MC_VERSION is picked automatically. See VERSIONS.md in the project for which loaders exist per Minecraft version. - OPS: comma separated usernames that become operators. It only adds; use /deop in-game to remove. - PERSIST: comma separated paths (e.g. world,ops.json,server.properties) that are kept in the Persistent folder and survive reinstalls. - "latest" is resolved once and then kept. Set UPDATE=true for one start to upgrade. Back up the world before upgrading Minecraft versions. - Console: open the container console (Unraid: container icon, Console) or run "docker attach minecraft-docker" and detach with Ctrl-P Ctrl-Q.

Config.Name: Server Port
Config.Description: Port players connect to. Container port must equal the SERVER_PORT variable below.

Config.Name: Server Data
Config.Description: World, server.properties, logs and installed server files.

Config.Name: Mods
Config.Description: Drop mod .jar files here, then restart the container.

Config.Name: Persistent
Config.Description: Holds the paths listed in PERSIST. Survives reinstalls and deleting the Server Data folder.

Config.Name: EULA
Config.Description: Set to true to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA).

Config.Name: MC_VERSION
Config.Description: Exact Minecraft version (e.g. 1.21.1 or 26.2), latest or latest-snapshot.

Config.Name: LOADER_VERSION
Config.Description: Empty = recommended (Forge) or newest stable (others). Or latest, or an exact version such as 21.1.172.

Config.Name: SERVER_PORT
Config.Description: Port the server listens on inside the container. Must equal the container port of the Server Port mapping above.

Config.Name: OPS
Config.Description: Operators, comma separated Minecraft usernames (e.g. Notch,jeb_). Only adds; remove with /deop in-game.

Config.Name: PERSIST
Config.Description: Comma separated paths kept in the Persistent folder, e.g. world,ops.json,whitelist.json,banned-players.json,server.properties

Config.Name: OP_LEVEL
Config.Description: Operator permission level (1-4) for newly added operators.

Config.Name: MEMORY_MIN
Config.Description: Initial Java heap (-Xms). Empty = same as MEMORY.

Config.Name: UPDATE
Config.Description: Set to true for one start to re-resolve latest / empty LOADER_VERSION, then set back to false. Back up the world first.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).
